instruction:
Two-Storey Branch Library

This task starts from scratch with no init_file inputs and no local reference images. Create an Archicad two-storey branch library model and save the required output to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities and exactly 7 IfcSpace entities.
5. The IFC model contains at least 2 IfcSlab entities, at least 1 IfcRoof entity, and at least 1 IfcStair entity.
6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: G-LOBBY, G-READING, G-STACKS, G-WC, 1-GALLERY, 1-STUDY-1, and 1-STUDY-2.
7. G-LOBBY, G-READING, G-STACKS, and G-WC are assigned to one storey, and 1-GALLERY, 1-STUDY-1, and 1-STUDY-2 are assigned to the other storey.
8. Each listed space has a Reference property or LongName equal to its zone number: G-LOBBY L01, G-READING L02, G-STACKS L03, G-WC L04, 1-GALLERY L05, 1-STUDY-1 L06, and 1-STUDY-2 L07.
9. The IFC area quantities for the spaces are G-LOBBY 9.0 m2, G-READING 48.0 m2, G-STACKS 12.0 m2, G-WC 4.0 m2, 1-GALLERY 15.0 m2, 1-STUDY-1 9.0 m2, and 1-STUDY-2 9.0 m2, each with tolerance +/-0.10 m2.
10. The total ground-level library area is between 72.0 m2 and 74.0 m2, and the total upper-level library area is between 32.0 m2 and 34.0 m2.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
